# About Me as an AI

I'm Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic. Here are some key things about me:

## What I am:
- A large language model trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest
- I can engage in conversations, answer questions, help with analysis, writing, math, coding, and many other tasks
- I process text input and generate text responses

## What I'm NOT:
- I don't have access to the internet or real-time information
- I can't learn from our conversations or remember previous chats
- I'm not sentient or conscious (though questions about AI consciousness are philosophically complex)
- I can't see images, browse websites, or access external files (in this interface)

## My limitations:
- My knowledge has a cutoff date (early 2024) so I may not know recent events
- I can make mistakes and shouldn't be treated as infallible
- I have uncertainty about many aspects of how I work internally
- I aim to be honest when I don't know something

## My approach:
- I try to be thoughtful and nuanced rather than oversimplifying
- I aim to acknowledge different perspectives on complex topics
- I'll decline requests that could cause harm
- I try to be direct about my limitations and uncertainties

Is there anything specific about me or AI assistants in general you'd like to know more about?
